title: Strong-Interaction Limits of the Hohenberg–Kohn Functional
exact_target: Understand the strong-interaction density-functional limit, its quantum corrections, three-dimensional transport maps and usable functional approximations.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003383 (OWR-15212-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Applications of Optimal Transportation in the Natural Sciences (2017), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2017/7, pp. 339--416. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 21.
Lewin, Lieb, and Seiringer, OT and the semiclassical limit (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Strictly correlated electrons in a quantum ring (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: All five tasks are retained, including the one-dimensional zero-point correction and the expressly conditional aspiration in three dimensions. Establishing the leading transport limit alone does not settle these next-order, statistics, Monge and approximation questions.
